Alibaba announced a major restructuring plan to split its US$257 billion empire into six independent entities last Tuesday, saying it would lead to quicker decision-making and give each unit greater operational independence.
Each company will be allowed to “pursue fundraising from third parties and IPOs when they are ready,” said Daniel Zhang Yong, chairman and chief executive of Alibaba, which also owns the South China Morning Post.
The other five units to be devolved are Cloud Intelligence Group, Taobao Tmall Commerce Group, Local Services Group, Global Digital Commerce Group and the Digital Media and Entertainment Group.

阿里巴巴董事长兼首席执行官张勇表示，每家公司将被允许“在准备好后从第三方筹集资金并进行首次公开募股(IPO)。”阿里巴巴还拥有《南华早报》。
其他五个将被剥离的单位分别是云智能集团、淘宝天猫商务集团、本地服务集团、全球数字商务集团和数字媒体与娱乐集团。

The Texas-based carmaker was once viewed by Chinese drivers as synonymous with intelligent EVs. After its Shanghai-made Model 3s hit the mainland market in January 2020, it drew rave reviews from Chinese drivers, even as Covid-19 wreaked havoc on the country’s economy and hit consumption. The Model 3 was the mainland’s bestselling EV until it was dethroned in September 2020 by a mini EV assembled by SAIC-GM-Wuling.
Tesla remains very popular. Last year, it delivered more than 710,000 Model 3s and Model Ys to customers on the mainland, a year-on-year increase of 50 per cent. In comparison, Beijing-based Li Auto, Tesla’s nearest rival, handed over just 133,246 units to customers last year, but a year-on-year increase of 47 per cent for the Chinese carmaker.

这家总部位于德克萨斯州的汽车制造商曾被中国驾驶者视为智能电动汽车的代名词。2020年1月，由上海制造的Model 3进入内地市场后，它获得了中国驾驶者的高度评价，尽管当时新冠病毒对中国经济造成严重影响，损害了消费。Model 3曾是内地最畅销的电动汽车，但在2020年9月被上汽通用五菱组装的一款迷你电动汽车所取代。
特斯拉依然非常受欢迎。去年，它在内地向客户交付了超过71万辆Model 3和Model Y，同比增长50%。相比之下，总部位于北京的特斯拉最接近的竞争对手理想汽车去年仅向客户交付了133,246辆汽车，但这对中国汽车制造商来说已经是同比增长47%。
